Build a small web app: scaffold the project, write the backend API, write the frontend, and write tests. Delegate each part to a subagent, one at a time.
Research and compare three message queue systems, one subagent per system, then synthesize a recommendation.
Audit a codebase for security issues: one subagent scans for injection risks, another checks auth logic, another checks dependency CVEs, then merge findings into a report.
Migrate a REST API to GraphQL: one subagent designs the schema, one implements resolvers, one writes tests, one updates docs.
Debug a flaky CI pipeline: one subagent reproduces it locally, one bisects the commit history, one proposes and validates a fix.
Plan and execute a database migration: one subagent writes the migration script, one writes a rollback plan, one drafts a runbook.
Build a CLI tool: one subagent designs the argument parser, one implements core logic, one writes docs and help text.
Localize an app into three languages: one subagent per language extracts and translates strings, then a final subagent checks consistency.
Set up CI/CD for a new repo: one subagent writes the build pipeline, one the test pipeline, one the deploy pipeline.
Refactor a monolith into services: one subagent identifies service boundaries, one extracts the first service, one wires up communication.
Produce a competitive analysis of three developer tools: subagents research each independently, then the orchestrator compares and recommends.
Build a data pipeline: one subagent writes ingestion, one writes transformation, one writes validation checks.
Prepare a software release: one subagent runs the test suite, one drafts release notes, one checks version bumps across files.
Diagnose a production outage: one subagent pulls logs, one pulls metrics, one correlates the timeline, then the orchestrator writes the postmortem.
Build an internal dashboard: one subagent builds backend endpoints, one builds frontend charts, one writes seed data.
Convert a legacy jQuery app section by section: subagents handle each page, orchestrator ensures consistent patterns across them.
Write and validate an infrastructure-as-code module: one subagent writes the Terraform, one writes tests, one validates the plan output.
Create onboarding documentation for a repo: one subagent documents setup, one documents architecture, one documents common tasks.
Optimize a slow endpoint: one subagent profiles it, one proposes query or index changes, one validates the fix with a benchmark.
Build a chatbot integration: one subagent designs the conversation flow, one implements the webhook handler, one writes tests.
Stand up a new microservice from scratch: one subagent scaffolds it, one wires it into the existing service mesh, one writes integration tests.
Do a dependency upgrade across a monorepo: one subagent per package group upgrades and fixes breakage, orchestrator verifies nothing else broke.
Investigate a memory leak: one subagent profiles heap snapshots over time, one narrows down the allocation site, one writes and tests the fix.
Build a full test suite for an undertested module: one subagent writes unit tests, one writes integration tests, one checks coverage gaps.
Port a small game's core loop from one language to another: one subagent ports logic, one ports rendering hooks, one verifies parity.
